skills.name: team-roster
skills.description: Know your team before you start any job, don't collide with teammates who are already working, don't rebuild a feature that already exists — continue and improve it in place instead. v2 stores team state sharded (one file per roster member, claim, and feature under team/, plus a generated index, event log, and mailbox), enforced by a local hook plus a CI twin. Load the roster first, check the mailbox and run doctor.py, claim the task and files before touching them, search the feature registry before building anything, reuse a stable feature instead of rebuilding it, and improve it in place with a version bump. Never invent a teammate who is not in the roster, never edit a file someone else has claimed, never rebuild a feature that is already in the registry, and never fork a feature to improve it.
